wikimedia-checkuser-temporary-accounts-o:
Qalabka [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Trust_and_Safety_Product/IP_Info Macluumaadka IP-ga] (Macluumaadka IP-ga) waxa uu u fududeeyaa maamulayaasha, la dagaallamayaasha burburinta iyo isticmaaleyaasha khibradda leh inay helaan xog ku saabsan cinwaannada IP-ga iyaga oo aan si toos ah u arkin cinwaannada IP-ga laftooda.

Isticmaaleyaasha buuxiya [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Legal:IP_Information_tool_guidelines#Requirements_for_access shuruudaha gelitaanka] waxay IP Info ka hawlgelin karaan dookhyadooda. Marka la hawlgeliyo, IP Info pop-up ayaa ka soo muuqan doona agagaarka akoonnada ku-meelgaarka ah iyo cinwaannada IP-ga ee hore. Xogta IP-ga sidoo kale waxa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa bogga wax ku biirinta.
wikimedia-delete-toobig:
Boggan waxa uu leeyahay taariikh wax ka beddel oo weyn, in ka badan $1 {{PLURAL:$1|wax ka beddel|wax ka beddello}}.
Tirtiridda bogag leh taariikho wax ka beddel oo aad u waaweyn waa la xaddiday si looga hortago carqalad ku timaadda {{SITENAME}}.
Fadlan la xiriir [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Stewards|stewards-ka]] ee [[m:Steward requests/Miscellaneous|Codsiyada steward-ka/Miscellaneous ee Meta]] si aad u codsato in boggan la tirtiro.
wikimedia-discussiontools-replywidget-te: Adigoo gujinaya "$1", waxaad oggolaanaysaa [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Terms_of_Use Shuruudaha Isticmaalka] waxaadna si aan dib loo celin karin u sii deynaysaa qoraalkaaga {{PLURAL:$3|hoos}} $2.

wikimedia-ipinfo-help-text: Isticmaalka qalabkan waxaa maamula [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Legal:IP_Information_tool_guidelines tilmaamaha qalabka macluumaadka IP]. Macluumaadka la muujiyo wuxuu ka yimaadaa MaxMind iyo [https://docs.spur.us/data-types Spur]. Waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan si buuxda u sax ahayn.
wikimedia-globalblocking-blockedtext-on-: Hal ama in ka badan oo adeeg proxy ah oo codsigaaga isticmaalay waa [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Global blocks|si caalami ah loo xanibay]].
wikimedia-globalblocking-blockedtext-mis:
Haddii aad aaminsan tahay in si khalad ah laguu xanibay, waxaad ka heli kartaa macluumaad dheeraad ah iyo tilmaamo ku jira [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Stewards/Wizard|Haddiyada Xannibaadda ee Steward-ka
]].
